{{Quote|Naturally, as the Crown Prince of Hapuntep, it breaks my heart to have to part with the royal diadem, but my people badly need medical supplies, and you, kind sir, are our last hope.|A con artist|<ref name="HR" />}}
The '''Crown Prince of Hapuntep''' was a [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchical]] title<ref name="HR" /> that shared its name with the [[Hapuntep system/Legends|Hapuntep system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> At one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified Human con artist|con artist]] presented themself to a person as the Crown Prince of Hapuntep, who purportedly possessed a royal diadem associated with their title. The [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] stated that the people they supposedly represented were in critical need of medical supplies and that therefore&mdash;although they claimed it caused them great sorrow&mdash;they were willing to part with their headdress so that the person they were addressing would help them out.<ref name="HR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The title of the Crown Prince of Hapuntep was mentioned in the [[1995]] sourcebook ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', authored by [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] and [[Paul Sudlow]] and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HR" />
